ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) screening for all shareholders, directors, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners against (i) Samoa FIU and Central Bank of Samoa published lists, (ii) OFAC SDN List, (iii) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, (iv) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and (v) domestic Samoa criminal and PEP databases. Given the MedTech regulatory consulting scope, a Low_Risk_Standard ML/TF profile applies, but PEP screening remains mandatory for any natural person owning ≥25% or exercising control over the Samoa International Company.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Office (SICO) — Online Name Search and Reservation Portal (via licensed registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed company name must be in the English/Latin character set; no Samoan language script is mandatory for an International Company. A transliteration to Latin script is required for any non-Latin origin name, with a certified translation into English. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or the relevant equivalent, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing name on the Samoa International Companies Register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent must file a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days from the date of rejection notice. The appeal must address the specific objection grounds and include a certified justification, amended name variants, and any supporting regulatory approvals for sensitive tokens. The Registrar must respond in writing within 21 business days. If rejected again, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Samoa for judicial review or re-submit under a substantially different proposed name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are permissible for the Samoa International Company only when a licensed full-service registered agent in Samoa provides a physical street address, a dedicated registered office, and compliance back-office services. Purely standalone virtual office addresses without an active licensed registered agent and local compliance infrastructure are not acceptable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated at approximately 1% per year for low-risk standard MedTech regulatory consulting entities; however, if UBO or sanctions screening flags PEP exposure, the risk of unannounced inspection rises to a moderate level (estimated 5-10% per year).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended - Part II (ss. 6-10: incorporation, memorandum of association, registered office, registered agent) and ss. 42-43 (statutory records and registers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged on Application for Registration of an International Company (Form ICA-01), leading to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation under the Registrar's seal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is statutorily required for an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987; the founding subscriber holds one ordinary share, no escrow or paid-up depositary account is mandated, and issued capital may be denominated in US dollars or another foreign currency
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company adopt the Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged with the Registrar of International Companies and that one fully paid ordinary share be allotted to the founding subscriber. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa. RESOLVED that [Name] and [Name] be appointed directors and that [Name] be Chairperson, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Chief Executive Officer for the first term ending at the first annual general meeting. RESOLVED that the directors be authorised to open bank accounts, execute the Medical Device FDA 510(k)/CE Mark regulatory consulting contracts, and affix the common seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - Registry of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names (with 'International Company' or 'IC' suffix) through a licensed registered agent; the Registrar checks the names index for identical or confusingly similar entries and verifies that restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Insurance', or 'Trust' are not used without a separate licence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as confusingly similar, file a written objection or substitute-name request with the Registrar within 14 days and resubmit alternative names for re-search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, execution and notarisation of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and Samoa Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and, if desired, Articles of Association in English; the sole subscriber executes the documents before a Notary Public; the registered agent countersigns the consent to act and verifies specimen signatures; all stated share capital is expressed in a permitted foreign currency.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association (optional if incorporated by reference)
Subscriber consent and specimen signature page
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon any requisition from the Registrar for defective execution or missing consents, correct and re-submit the instrument within 21 days of the requisition notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of incorporation application and payment of fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the application for registration together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent's consent, and the US$100 official fee; upon approval the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, and the company is deemed incorporated on the date of issue.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, satisfy the Registrar's requisition within 30 days, pay any prescribed shortfall fee, and re-file; failure to respond causes the application to be deemed withdrawn, subject to refund policy re-application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of first directors, officers and statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting through the registered agent's corporate services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold and minute the first board meeting adopting the pro-forma resolution; record appointments of directors, Chairperson, Secretary, and Chief Executive Officer; open the statutory register of directors, register of members, and register of charges at the registered office in Apia.
required_dossiers: Specimen signatures of directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Internal board minutes are not lodged with the Registry; any omission in the statutory registers is cured by a written rectification resolution and backdated entries supported by board approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of share certificates, seal and registered office confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Issue the share certificate for the allotted ordinary share, affix the common seal to the certificate and contracts, and confirm the registered office address for service of process; notify the Registrar in writing of any later change of registered office within 21 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office changes, file the prescribed notice of change with SIFA; late filing is cured by payment of the late filing fee and submission of a declaration of accuracy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation business licence review and bank account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) for business licence (if physical office); commercial bank selected by the Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the Company's purely offshore regulatory consulting services are exempt from an industrial licence; if a physical Apia workplace is established, apply for a Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998; open a corporate bank account using the Certificate of Incorporation, charter documents, and board banking resolution, with wire and credit card payment rails approved.
required_dossiers: Notarised first board resolution on bank signatories
Beneficial ownership and AML/KYC due diligence pack
Business Licence application (only if physical office in Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional information, supply a certified copy of the register of members, register of directors, and a reliance letter from the registered agent; unresolved queries may be escalated through the bank's compliance approval committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licence Division (not applicable to the Company's offshore consulting scope; only relevant if a physical workplace is later established in Samoa)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or manufacturing operating permit applies to ISIC 7490 medical device regulatory consulting; the Company relies on the Certificate of Incorporation and, if an office is opened, a Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Exempt: office-only professional consultancy generating no construction or industrial disturbance; no Environmental Impact Assessment report or development consent is required for the company's administrative use of a leased office
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or effluent thresholds are triggered for administrative consulting services; office waste handling must comply with the Waste Management Act 2005, including segregation of e-waste and secure disposal of confidential client documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Clearance Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) for the office premises; structural load and occupancy clearance per the Building Code under the Planning and Urban Management Regulations; workplace safety alignment with the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 and Accident Compensation Corporation coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (MfR), being the national tax authority of the Independent State of Samoa, with public electronic services and portal access at https://www.revenue.gov.ws; the Ministry administers the Tax Administration Act 2012, the Income Tax Act 2015, and the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2016, while the Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) maintains company registration records for international companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoa International Company ('IC') obtains a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique IC registration number from the Registrar of International Companies (MCIL) upon incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987. Because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt, no Samoan TIN or VAGST identity number is required for purely offshore operations. If the IC nonetheless triggers domestic tax exposure by employing persons in Samoa (PAYE), importing goods (customs/VAGST), or conducting any taxable activity in Samoa, it must apply to the MfR for a TIN and, where annual taxable turnover meets the VAGST threshold, complete VAGST registration through the MfR registration desk or online portal. The foreign entity must maintain a licensed registered agent in Samoa and provide certified copies of its certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, board resolutions, and identity documents of directors and shareholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — a Samoa International Company is a non-resident offshore entity exempt from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, VAGST, and stamp duty on all income, profits, gains, and transactions arising outside Samoa under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended). The IC is further prohibited from carrying on domestic business with Samoan residents and incurs only the annual government fee; no tax return or income tax registration obligation arises while the entity remains in compliance with its offshore-only purpose.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not maintain a domestic 'check-the-box' entity classification election; the tax status of an IC is fixed by statute and is automatically exempt. Available statutory mechanisms include continuation into or out of Samoa, redomiciliation, voluntary election to be wound up or converted, and instrument-based governance elections under the International Companies Act 1987. For foreign tax planning, the IC may be subject to an entity classification election made under the tax law of another jurisdiction (e.g., U.S. Form 8832), and the exemption is not conditional on any Samoan filing. Samoa's domestic legislation does not provide a hybrid mismatch election regime applicable to ICs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) — a territorial consumption tax imposed under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2016 (as amended), administered by the Ministry for Revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 50,000 (compulsory registration applies to a supplier carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa whose taxable turnover in any 12-month period exceeds or is reasonably expected to exceed 50,000 Samoan Tala; voluntary registration is available for suppliers below the threshold).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API-based digital stamping, or third-party invoice clearance. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue sequential tax invoices containing the prescribed particulars (supplier and recipient names and addresses, both parties' VAGST registration numbers, description of supply, taxable value, and VAGST charged) and must retain records in Samoa or in a form accessible electronically to the Ministry. Returns are lodged through the MfR's online filing system, and the Ministry may require electronic data extraction during audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAGST-registered supplier may zero-rate: (i) exported goods in respect of which the supplier holds and retains customs evidence of physical export from Samoa within the prescribed time; (ii) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and that are not used, enjoyed, or consumed in Samoa; and (iii) supplies to prescribed international, diplomatic, or donor bodies. For the present IC, offshore FDA 510(k) and CE Mark regulatory consulting services are supplied to non-resident medical device manufacturers and are sourced entirely outside Samoa; the tax-exempt IC is outside the VAGST net altogether, so no VAGST is chargeable and no input tax refund arises because exempt offshore operations do not incur Samoan input VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs export declaration (authorized electronic Customs Declaration/Export Entry lodged in the Customs Management System)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods from Samoa
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice from a licensed commercial bank in Samoa evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
VAGST-registered supplier's tax invoice and zero-rating substantiation file, including transport and insurance documents where applicable
Certificate of Origin, if preferential tariff treatment or treaty-based documentation is claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The MfR may audit zero-rated supplies, deny refunds, and retrospectively claw back wrongfully claimed input credits or zero-rated output tax together with statutory interest. Under the Tax Administration Act 2012, shortfall penalties apply at 25% of the tax shortfall for failure to take reasonable care, 75% for reckless conduct, and 150% for intentional, concealed, or fraudulent misconduct; late payment attracts a recurring penalty of 1.5% per month or part of a month, in addition to interest. Fraudulent export zero-rating, false customs declarations, or fabricated outward remittance documentation may further result in criminal prosecution (fines and imprisonment), cancellation or suspension of VAGST registration, seizure of goods, and public disclosure of penalised taxpayers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa, constituted under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and administering the Exchange Control Regulations 1984 in conjunction with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) for offshore-company matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tālā (WST) is not freely convertible. Current-account convertibility for residents operates through CBS-licensed authorized dealers upon documentary verification, while resident capital-account transactions require CBS exchange-control approval. A Samoa International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 is statutorily exempt from all exchange-control restrictions pursuant to section 192 of that Act; the IC may therefore freely receive, hold, pay, and remit in any convertible currency (notably USD and EUR for FDA 510(k) and CE Mark consulting fees) without WST conversion obligations or central-bank capital-movement veto, subject only to AML/CFT verification at the receiving bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds to an authorized dealer in Samoa within the statutory period of 30 days from receipt and offer 100% of the foreign currency for conversion into WST unless a specific exemption is granted by the CBS. International companies are expressly excluded from these surrender and conversion requirements by operation of section 192 of the International Companies Act 1987; the IC's consulting and regulatory-compliance fee receivables may consequently be retained offshore or onshore in USD/EUR and disbursed without surrender to the central bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (multi-currency USD, EUR, WST)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa has no standalone electronic-money-institution (EMI) or non-bank payment-institution licensing regime, and offshore digital EMIs are not recognized as deposit-taking or settlement institutions eligible for CBS clearing access. Cross-border digital payouts and credit-card fee capture are permitted only through licensed commercial banks or regulated international card acquirers sponsored by a Samoan bank; an offshore EMI cannot independently hold client funds in Samoa or issue a local settlement account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attestation is the prevailing standard: at least one director and the registered agent must complete an in-person identity verification, or the director must execute a notarized signature and passport attestation before a Samoan consulate, embassy, or a recognized notary in the director's home jurisdiction where the bank accepts remote verification under enhanced due diligence. In practice, foreign-resident directors should appoint a Samoan-licensed registered agent under a limited power of attorney and be prepared for a video-conference KYC interview with the bank's Compliance Officer, with bank approval conditioned on the submission of a professional banker's reference from the director's existing financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity caused by non-resident directors and a trust-based or multi-tier shareholding structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the IC certificate of incorporation; current register of directors, shareholders, and charges; completed beneficial-ownership declaration under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) record rules; trust deed or trust extract where a trust is a shareholder; and a sealed compliance certificate from the Samoan registered agent confirming the register is current, accurate, and free from nominee concealment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status red-flagged as a possible shell or tax-evasion vehicle
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic-substance file demonstrating management and control exercised in Samoa; executed FDA 510(k) and European CE Mark consulting contracts itemizing deliverables and fee schedules; invoices and matching bank-statement evidence; office lease and staff/contractor payroll documentation; board minutes approving the regulatory consultancy business plan; and a written narrative distinguishing the IC as an active MedTech regulatory consultancy rather than a passive holding company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds suspicion on the initial share-capital injection from a non-resident shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month bank statements of the remitting shareholder; incorporation and ownership records of the funding entity; tax clearance or certificate of good standing from the home jurisdiction; a statutory declaration of source of wealth signed by the shareholder; and a solicitor's opinion confirming that the funds derive from lawful accumulated FDA/CE compliance fee receivables or other documented commercial earnings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person (PEP) or adverse-media hit on a director or ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP questionnaire; corroborated source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations supported by salary, brokerage, pension, or estate documentation; independent reputational due-diligence report from a screening provider; and a written explanation demonstrating that any PEP interest is passive, transparent, and wholly unrelated to Samoan public-office functions or procurement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injection is executed by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home bank to the IC's USD settlement account at Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) Limited via BSP's Australian correspondent, with the remittance narrative referencing 'IC SHARE SUBSCRIPTION WS_IC' and the IC registration number. The sending institution must apply the appropriate BPM6 purpose code for a direct-capital injection; no CBS exchange-control approval is required for ICs, but the receiving Samoan bank requires the completed source-of-funds dossier, an AML clearance certificate from the sending bank, and a funds-declaration form where the credit exceeds the bank's reporting threshold of WST 50,000 equivalent. A pro-forma invoice, share-allotment resolution, and board resolution authorizing the account opening must be retained to evidence the commercial substance of the capital flow.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for FDA 510(k) submission fees, European notified-body CE Mark testing costs, and subcontracted regulatory consultancy services is made by SWIFT MT103 and MT202 in USD/EUR from the IC's multi-currency account to the beneficiary's designated bank; for larger procurement of medical-device testing hardware, a documentary commercial letter of credit (irrevocable, confirmed by a top-tier European or US bank) is used with ICC UCP 600 terms and the IC's bank as issuing institution. Samoan authorized dealers transmit instructions through their US and Australian correspondent networks, and payment narratives must cite the underlying contract number and invoice reference to satisfy AML transaction-monitoring and the receiving beneficiary bank's compliance review. Credit-card fee intake from consulting clients is captured through a licensed card acquirer sponsored by a Samoan commercial bank, with settlement in USD and automatic conversion into the IC's operational account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR deliverable FX forward contracts and rolling-forward agreements executed with an OECD-level offshore bank counterparty (London or New York) that accepts the Samoa IC's full KYC/EDD onboarding file, used to lock conversion costs between FDA 510(k) USD receivables and CE Mark EUR disbursements.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on WST/USD arranged through a licensed derivatives broker or an authorized-dealer bank outside Samoa for the limited purpose of netting incidental Samoan operating-currency exposure without creating onshore WST deliverability risk.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD and EUR with duration matching the expected FDA and CE Mark fee cycles, converting fixed-rate USD regulatory retainers into EUR streams for European notified-body payments.

Plain-vanilla FX call and put options purchased on a zero-premium-budget-capped basis to protect against adverse EUR/USD movement on one-off high-value regulatory filing milestones, with short-option writing expressly excluded from treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary date each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late fee applies for delinquent returns; IC ceases to be in good standing; continued non-payment for 6 months permits the Registrar to publish a strike-off notice; on strike-off, assets vest in the State.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Fee (IC Annual Charge)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, paid through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default interest accrues on overdue fees; good-standing status lapses after 90 days; after 30 days' Gazette notice the Registrar may strike the company off the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies (Central Competent Authority), MCIL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the date prescribed under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act, aligned with the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file attracts monetary penalties; the Registrar may require audited financial statements, curtail tax-exempt confirmation, and ultimately initiate strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (maintained on file; produced to the Registrar upon request)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of agent confirmation impedes certification of good standing; agent non-compliance with MCIL oversight may result in suspension or deregistration of the agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Samoa International Company is exempt from compulsory audit unless it is listed, regulated, carries on a relevant economic substance activity requiring audited accounts, or unless members holding not less than 10% of voting rights requisition an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for Samoa international companies; accounts may be maintained in USD or any major trading currency.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every transfer of shares must be entered in the Register of Members within 21 days of transfer; on each incorporation anniversary the registered agent must obtain a signed confirmation from members and directors updating beneficial ownership details; a confidential beneficial ownership register is maintained by the agent at the registered office.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 - 1,500 per annum for standard registered office and licensed agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 7,500 depending on transaction volume and group structure

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (International Company exemption; ordinary Samoan resident companies taxed at 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption from Samoan income tax on all international business income; no capital gains tax, no gift or estate tax, no branch remittance tax, and no exchange control restrictions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: SIC Annual Return – Form IA-7 filed electronically via the Samoa Ministry of Revenue Online Tax Administration System (OTAS) and submitted to the Registrar of International Companies at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Labour
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is the last working day of the sixth month following the International Company's financial year-end (e.g., 31 December year-end must file by 30 June)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name of the International Company exactly as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the legal name in full, including the 'Limited' suffix; no abbreviations are accepted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company registration number issued by the Samoa Registry
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the unique alpha-numeric registry code; ensure no leading zeros are omitted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa Tax Identification Number (TIN) allocated by the Ministry of Revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC is issued a TIN for annual filing and administrative correspondence; enter the 9-digit TIN without hyphens

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoan-source gross income derived during the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a fully compliant International Company, this is normally zero. Any Samoan-source income forfeits the exemption and requires a full corporate tax return (Form CTR-1)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying the International Company exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' in all tax computation fields unless the exemption is lost; if taxable income is positive, attach a schedule of foreign-source income and expenses

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa (required physical location)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the street address of the licensed Samoan service provider; a P.O. Box alone is not acceptable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continued compliance with the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) and AML/CFT laws
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a current director or authorized company secretary; electronic signature via OTAS is accepted for non-resident directors

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: WST 100 per month or part of a month up to WST 2,000 per form. Failure to produce records: WST 5,000 administrative penalty per inspection. Knew or willful omissions can trigger prosecution, with fines up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for International Company distributions to non-residents; ordinary Samoan companies paying dividends to non-residents are subject to a 15% withholding tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced treaty rate on dividends, interest, or royalties paid from Samoa, the payee must submit a completed Deduction for Treaty Relief Form (DR-3) to the Ministry of Revenue before the payment date. The form must be accompanied by a Certificate of Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, a Form 6166 or equivalent, and a statement confirming beneficial ownership. The Ministry of Revenue issues a formal ruling within 15 business days; payments made before the approval may incur the statutory 15% WHT regardless of treaty eligibility
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates for payments to non-residents: Royalties 15% and Interest 15%. Under the Samoa / New Zealand and Samoa / Australia DTAs, royalty and interest WHT are generally reduced to 10%. International Companies paying royalties or interest to non-residents are exempt from Samoan WHT provided the payment does not relate to a Samoan-source activity

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa Income Tax Act (Section 52A) requires contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation for any controlled transaction where the aggregate annual value exceeds WST 2,000,000 or where exempt entities have intra-group services exceeding WST 1,000,000. There is no statutory requirement to prepare Local File or Master File for fully exempt International Companies unless the exemption is disclaimed or local-source income is earned
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) does not explicitly prescribe economic substance, but Samoa's Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AMLCFT) Act 2017 requires each IC to maintain a registered office, keep adequate accounting records, and demonstrate a legitimate commercial purpose. A company failing economic substance criteria may be deemed a 'shell' for tax evasion purposes, triggering loss of the IC exempt status and application of ordinary Samoan corporate income tax at 27%

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – Loss of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deriving Samoan-source income (e.g., local consulting fees for FDA/CE regulatory advice) and not disclosing it in the annual return, or claiming the exemption while conducting prohibited local commercial activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive revocation of exempt status; assessment of unpaid corporate tax for three years plus penalties of up to 150% of the underpaid tax; late payment surcharge of 2% per month on outstanding amounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director is jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid tax. Willful evasion is a criminal offense carrying a fine not exceeding WST 200,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 7 years. A director may also be subject to a travel ban and personal property restraint pending resolution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mailbox company with no physical presence in Samoa, no domestic nominee services, or refusing to provide bank account and corporate record documentation to the Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Striking the company off the International Companies Register; administrative penalty of WST 50,000–WST 150,000; confiscation of any assets claimed under the exempt IC status; mandatory outing in the Samoan corporate registry as a non-operational entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified for up to 5 years. If the shell structure is used to facilitate fraud, directors face civil liability for all debts incurred while the company lacked substance, plus criminal prosecution for false declarations with imprisonment up to 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting bank wire or credit card payments for FDA/CE consulting without conducting customer due diligence or without registering as a reportable entity for AML purposes when such consulting services attract Samoan territorial nexus
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to WST 500,000 for the company; capability to freeze bank accounts; with AML/CFT violations being subject to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit's enforcement action, including cancellation of the company's registered office license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal monetary penalties of WST 100,000 and imprisonment of up to 10 years for enabling money laundering or terrorist financing. Travel restrictions are routinely imposed pending legal process

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Declaration to the Tax Authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an annual return that misrepresents the nature of business activities, hides a substantial non-resident parent entity's management role, or falsely certifies that no Samoan-source income will be earned
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A strict-liability civil fine of WST 25,000 per declaration; criminal conviction for perjury in tax documents carries a fine of up to WST 100,000 plus imprisonment of up to 3 years; subsequent disallowance of all deductions and exemptions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The tax authority can pierce the corporate veil and recover unpaid taxes directly from directors' assets. In addition to restitution and interest, directors can face a 5-year entry bar into Samoa and removal from the company register as an authorized officer
